einzeiler: Comedians Andy Beckerman and Naomi Ekperigen analyze Hollywood's most toxic duos.
kurzfassung: The hosts of the Full Stop podcast are joined by Naomi Ekperigen and Andy Beckerman from the Couples Therapy podcast to discuss notoriously difficult creative partnerships. Together, they examine the turbulent backstage dynamics between Tom Cruise and Anne Rice, Patrick Swayze and Jennifer Grey, and Elizabeth Taylor and Richard Burton. Throughout the conversation, the group explores how intense artistic pressure and a lack of workplace boundaries fuel these legendary cinematic clashes.
stichpunkte: Naomi Ekperigen and Andy Beckerman join the show to unpack three historically dysfunctional movie relationships.
The guests and hosts discuss Tom Cruise being cast as Lestat against the fierce objections of author Anne Rice.
Anne Rice mobilized an active fan base and publicly slammed Cruise's casting in Interview with the Vampire before eventually praising his performance.
The conversation turns to Patrick Swayze and Jennifer Grey clashing on the set of Dirty Dancing due to his intense demeanor and pranks.
Jennifer Grey recalled Swayze showing up too drunk to remember lines for their love scene and pulling an inappropriate stunt to force a laugh out of her.
The panel examines Elizabeth Taylor and Richard Burton's volatile romance during the extravagant, disaster-plagued production of Cleopatra.
Burton and Taylor's intense affair sparked international scandals, condemnation from the Vatican, and constant media pursuit.
The group reflects on how the lack of professional boundaries and the summer-camp atmosphere of film sets enable toxic workplace behavior.

clips.text: The discussion highlights how the author successfully rallied a large crowd to protest outside a book signing with chants against the lead actor.
A classic 1980s romance pulled in over two hundred million dollars globally despite starting with a very modest budget.
An actor exposed himself on camera during a take to shock his co-star out of a fit of giggles.
An iconic historical epic became the most expensive movie ever made at the time of its release in the early 1960s.
The newspaper published by the Holy See issued a public letter criticizing the romantic conduct of two major movie stars.

beschreibung: This week we have Andy Beckerman and Naomi Ekperigin from the Couples Therapy podcast to discuss some of the most chaotic creative partnerships and rivalries in Hollywood history. Join us as we lay out an array of feuds from Tom Cruise vs. Anne Rice, to Patrick Swayze vs. Jennifer Grey, and beyond. Grab yourself a bucket of Liz Taylor’s favorite chili and get ready to pick a side. Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.
